title: 正新c1808公路车外胎
notes: Question post (2025-03-23) about the C1808 28C. Owner replies: average and loud but decent puncture protection; easy to remove but punctured five times in its worst month; two flats for another rider; one year as the original tire on a Tornado 600 with small wear pits and one pinch cut but no punctures. One commenter paid about CNY 150 for two. Another placed it between the durable C3045 and the racing C1922 in CST's range.
